principle: Choose the intelligence substrate per loop: model reasoning, ADK-style workflow, semantic RAG, deterministic structured retrieval, extraction into structured fields, durable memory, external action, routine automation, or a hybrid.

substrates.name: Model-Only Reasoning
substrates.purpose: Use the model for reasoning or transformation when all needed context is already provided.
use_when: no durable source of truth required
p0_blockers: answers depend on data not provided
no way to detect missing source context

substrates.name: ADK-Style Workflow or Agent
substrates.purpose: Coordinate steps, tools, branches, approvals, and decisions through an agent/workflow architecture.
p0_blockers: tools can mutate externally without approval

substrates.name: Semantic RAG
substrates.purpose: Retrieve relevant unstructured or semi-structured passages for grounded answers.

substrates.name: Deterministic Structured Retrieval
substrates.purpose: Fetch exact facts from structured stores, APIs, indexes, and permission-scoped records.
p0_blockers: semantic search used for exact record state

substrates.name: LLM Extraction Into Structured Fields
substrates.purpose: Convert messy source material into durable structured records for retrieval, memory, reporting, or automation.

substrates.name: Durable Memory and Knowledge Graph
substrates.purpose: Persist user-specific or domain-specific context that compounds over time.
use_when: outcome feedback should improve future work

substrates.name: External Action Layer
substrates.purpose: Safely perform externally visible, paid, destructive, or production-mutating actions.

substrates.name: Routine and Automation Layer
substrates.purpose: Run bounded repeated work with triggers, state, budgets, outputs, and failure recovery.

decision_dimensions.name: Loop Intent
questions: Is this loop answering, deciding, transforming, extracting, remembering, coordinating, or acting?
Is the user asking for knowledge, action, or both?

decision_dimensions.name: Source of Truth
questions: Where must correct answers come from?
Is the source unstructured documents, structured records, user memory, live APIs, or web research?

decision_dimensions.name: Retrieval Shape
questions: Does the loop need semantic similarity, exact lookup, filtered records, or a hybrid?
Are citations, freshness, and permission scopes required?

decision_dimensions.name: Extraction Shape
questions: Does raw material need to become typed records?
What schema, provenance, confidence, and correction path are required?

decision_dimensions.name: Workflow Shape
questions: Does the system need steps, branches, tools, jobs, approvals, retries, or escalation?
Which steps are deterministic and which require model judgment?

decision_dimensions.name: Memory Shape
questions: Who can inspect, correct, export, or delete memory?

decision_dimensions.name: Action Risk
questions: Can the system write, publish, send, delete, spend, deploy, or mutate production data?
What preview, approval, audit, and rollback are required?

decision_dimensions.name: Evaluation and Trace
questions: What eval proves this architecture works?
What trace must be captured for retrieval, extraction, workflow steps, memory changes, and external actions?

domain_patterns.name: Social Content Operating System
domain_patterns.first_loop: capture proof/story -> extract structured memory -> retrieve relevant examples -> generate draft -> score -> approve

domain_patterns.name: Research Intelligence Copilot
domain_patterns.first_loop: define question -> gather cited sources -> extract claims -> synthesize -> critique citations -> publish internal brief

domain_patterns.name: Enterprise Knowledge Assistant
domain_patterns.first_loop: receive question -> retrieve scoped passages -> answer with citations -> log gaps

domain_patterns.name: Operations Workflow Agent
domain_patterns.first_loop: intake item -> classify -> retrieve account/context -> propose action -> approve/write -> log outcome

domain_patterns.name: Creative Media Agent
domain_patterns.first_loop: capture brief -> extract asset requirements -> generate option -> review output -> approve export

domain_patterns.name: Data Analyst Agent
domain_patterns.first_loop: select metric -> query structured data -> explain result -> flag anomaly -> save report
